_read_me: Easiest: run Start-Live-Broker, then on the Broker page click Connect on your broker and fill the form. It saves here for you. Never share this file or paste it in any chat.
_broker_choices: demo | kite | upstox | fyers | dhan | angel | breeze
_redirect_url_help: Leave empty to use http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback. If your broker app has a different redirect URL saved, put that exact URL here.
